title: It lay beneath him
html_source: The cynical and abusive mind (what Ellmann calls insensitives, p46n) of Buck Mulligan had mock blessed the mountains earlier. The wandering challenging thoughts and mental infrastructure of Stephen turns to the sea preempting his own odyssey on the Sandymount Strand in episode three : Proteus.
